pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyīcì zhīdào shào lǐ de míngzì , shìcóng yìzhāng xiǎng ràng tā qiānmíng de zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi first learned Shaoli's name from a paper he was being asked to sign.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一次知道邵里的名字，是从一张想让他签名的纸上。

pairs.target: nà rén bǎ zhǐ yā zài shuǐhú páng , shuō dōng wū měitiān liàn bùliǎo jǐzǔ , dàjiā dé yìqǐ qǐng lǎoshī duō kāi xiē shíchén .
pairs.english: The boy laid it beside the kettle, saying the east room accommodated too few groups each day; they should jointly ask for more practice hours.
pairs.hanzi: 那人把纸压在水壶旁，说东屋每天练不了几组，大家得一起请老师多开些时辰。

pairs.target: tā xiàgèyuè yào kǎo gōngwù shíxí , tíng guò de kè búhuì tì tā bǎ kǎoqī wǎnghòu tuī .
pairs.english: He had a public-works placement examination next month, and missed lessons would not postpone his exam date.
pairs.hanzi: 他下个月要考工务实习，停过的课不会替他把考期往后推。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū tā jiùshì zài shítáng wèn liú xiào de gāoniánjí xuéshēng , yìshí méi jiē bǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the older student who had asked about residual effects in the dining hall and hesitated to take the pen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出他就是在食堂问留效的高年级学生，一时没接笔。

pairs.target: shào lǐ yě rènchū tā , shuō nàwǎn de shì lǎoshī yǐjīng jiǎng le , zìjǐ tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Shaoli recognized him too and said the instructor had already explained that evening's incident; he had heard.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里也认出他，说那晚的事老师已经讲了，自己听见了。

pairs.target: huà dào zhèlǐ biàn tíng , xiàng yíshàn zhī kāi le yíbàn de mén .
pairs.english: His words stopped there, like a door only half open.
pairs.hanzi: 话到这里便停，像一扇只开了一半的门。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng le yíxià , jiàn méiyǒu hòu bànjù , jiù dītóu kàn zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi waited, then, finding no more coming, looked down at the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等了一下，见没有后半句，就低头看纸。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn xiě zēngjiā liànxí shíduàn , xiàmiàn yǐyǒu wǔgè míngzì .
pairs.english: It requested increased practice time; five names were already below.
pairs.hanzi: 上面写增加练习时段，下面已有五个名字。

pairs.target: tā quèshí yě xiǎng duō liàn , biàn xiě shàng zìjǐ de míngzì , shuō yàoshi pái zǎo yìdiǎn , zìjǐ néng lái .
pairs.english: He did want more practice, so signed his name and said he could come if they scheduled it earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 他确实也想多练，便写上自己的名字，说要是排早一点，自己能来。

pairs.target: shào lǐ diǎntóu , bǎ zhǐ názǒu . tǎ wéi méiyǒu zhuīwèn zǎo yìdiǎn jiūjìng shì nǎlǐ de yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Shaoli nodded and took the paper. Tavi did not ask exactly where that earlier time would come from.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里点头，把纸拿走。塔维没有追问早一点究竟是哪里的一点。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , tā hé dé mǎ zài dōng wū shōu jiājù , yīwén dài zhe sāngè rén lái jiē wūzi .
pairs.english: That afternoon, he and Dema were putting away fixtures in the east room when Iven arrived with three others to take over the room.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，他和德玛在东屋收夹具，伊文带着三个人来接屋子。

pairs.target: ménpái shàng de zhōngdiǎn gāng dào , shào lǐ què bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ tānkāi , shuō liànxí zhè jǐtiān yào yáncháng ,
pairs.english: The time on the door sign had just arrived, but Shaoli spread out the paper and said practice would run longer these next few days.
pairs.hanzi: 门牌上的钟点刚到，邵里却把那张纸摊开，说练习这几天要延长，

pairs.target: děng lǎoshī lái jiù néng dìng . yīwén fàngxià gē běn , wèn yándào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: It could be settled when the instructor came. Iven set down the songbooks and asked how much longer.
pairs.hanzi:
等老师来就能定。
伊文放下歌本，问延到哪里。

pairs.target: shào lǐ yòng zhǐtou qiāo le qiāo héchàngduì nà yìlán . " chànggē nuó yi nuó . xiān bǎ dānwù de bǔ shàng . "
pairs.english: Shaoli tapped the choir's entry with his finger. “Move the singing a little. Make up the lost time first.”
pairs.hanzi:
邵里用指头敲了敲合唱队那一栏。
“唱歌挪一挪。先把耽误的补上。”

pairs.target: yīwén kànjiàn tǎ wéi de míngzì , tíng le yíxià , méi wèn tā wèishénme .
pairs.english: Iven saw Tavi's name and paused without asking why.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看见塔维的名字，停了一下，没问他为什么。

pairs.target: tā jiào shēnhòu de rén xiān biébān dèngzǐ , zìjǐ bǎ ménpái shàng de yùyuē rìqī niàn chūlái .
pairs.english: He told the others not to move the stools yet and read aloud the reservation date on the door sign.
pairs.hanzi: 他叫身后的人先别搬凳子，自己把门牌上的预约日期念出来。

pairs.target: nà shì gōngfáng chūshì yǐqián jiù dìng hǎo de ,
pairs.english: It had been arranged before the workshop incident.
pairs.hanzi: 那是工房出事以前就定好的，

pairs.target: sāntiān hòu xī jiē de héchàng yě yǐjīng gàosù le fùjìn zhùhù , búshì jīntiān línshí xiǎng chàng .
pairs.english: Nearby residents had already been told of the West Steps singing three days from now; this was not a whim today.
pairs.hanzi: 三天后西阶的合唱也已经告诉了附近住户，不是今天临时想唱。

pairs.target: shào lǐ shuō méiyǒu búràng chàng , wǎnshàng yě néng chàng .
pairs.english: Shaoli said he was not forbidding singing; they could sing at night.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里说没有不让唱，晚上也能唱。

pairs.target: yīwén shēnhòu yígè zhābiànzi de gūniáng shuō tā tiānhēi qián dé huí xiàchéng ,
pairs.english: A braided girl behind Iven said she had to return to the lower city before dark.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文身后一个扎辫子的姑娘说她天黑前得回下城，

pairs.target: lìng yígè rén shuō wǎnshàng háiyào kàn pùzi , chúfēi kèrén yě gēnzhe héchàng .
pairs.english: Another said he had to mind a shop at night, unless the customers joined the choir too.
pairs.hanzi: 另一个人说晚上还要看铺子，除非客人也跟着合唱。

pairs.target: yǒurén xiào le yìshēng , hěnkuài yòu shōuzhù .
pairs.english: Someone gave a laugh, then quickly stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 有人笑了一声，很快又收住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ cā jiājù de bù zuàn zài shǒulǐ . tā yuánlái yǐwéi jiā de shì kōng zhe de shíhòu ,
pairs.english: Tavi gripped the cleaning cloth. He had thought they meant adding unused time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把擦夹具的布攥在手里。他原来以为加的是空着的时候，

pairs.target: kě wūzi cóngzǎodàowǎn yǒurén , kōng chūlái de měi yì gé zǒngděi cóng shuí shǒulǐ ná .
pairs.english: But the room was occupied from morning to night. Every freed slot had to be taken from someone.
pairs.hanzi: 可屋子从早到晚有人，空出来的每一格总得从谁手里拿。

pairs.target: tā zǎoshàng lián zhè zhāng biǎo yě méi láikàn , jiù qiān le míngzì .
pairs.english: He had signed that morning without even looking at this schedule.
pairs.hanzi: 他早上连这张表也没来看，就签了名字。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi dāying zhàn tāmen de shíchén . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I didn't agree to take their time,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我没答应占他们的时辰。”他说。

pairs.target: shào lǐ kàn tā yìyǎn , shuō bú zhàn , yándào nǎlǐ qù .
pairs.english: Shaoli glanced at him and asked where else they could extend it.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里看他一眼，说不占，延到哪里去。

pairs.target: lǎoshī néng lái de báitiān jiù zhème cháng , bùnéng yīnwèi péngyǒu zài zhèlǐ , yòu shuō zìjǐ bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: The daylight hours when teachers could come were limited; he couldn't claim ignorance again just because his friend was here.
pairs.hanzi: 老师能来的白天就这么长，不能因为朋友在这里，又说自己不知道。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng fǎnbó péngyǒu liǎnggè zì , què fāxiàn ruò jīntiān lái de shì biéde rén , tā kěnéng zhēn búhuì zhème kuài kāikǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to challenge the word “friend,” then realized that if someone else had arrived today, he might not have spoken so quickly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想反驳朋友两个字，却发现若今天来的是别的人，他可能真不会这么快开口。

pairs.target: dé mǎ bǎ zuìhòu yìzhī jiājù zhuāngjìn xiāngzǐ , wèn néng bunéng fēn liǎngtiān , gè ràng yíbàn .
pairs.english: Dema packed the last fixture into the box and asked whether they could split it over two days, each yielding half.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛把最后一只夹具装进箱子，问能不能分两天，各让一半。

pairs.target: tā shuō de shíhòu kànzhe yīwén , bú xiàng shào lǐ nàyàng zhī kàn biǎo .
pairs.english: She looked at Iven as she spoke, unlike Shaoli, who only looked at the schedule.
pairs.hanzi: 她说的时候看着伊文，不像邵里那样只看表。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zhè shì zuìhòu yícì bǎ jǐduàn jiē qǐlái chàng , bàngè shíchén zhī gòu rén dào qí ,
pairs.english: Iven said this was their last chance to sing all the sections together. Half an hour would barely get everyone assembled.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说这是最后一次把几段接起来唱，半个时辰只够人到齐，

pairs.target: bùnéng tì lìngwài shíjǐgè rén dāying shǎo yíbàn . " nǐmen búshì yě dé xiān wèn wǒmen ma ? "
pairs.english: He couldn't agree on behalf of a dozen others to lose half their time. “Shouldn't you ask us first too?”
pairs.hanzi:
不能替另外十几个人答应少一半。
“你们不是也得先问我们吗？”

pairs.target: dé mǎ dītóu shuō shì , bǎ xiāng kòu hé shàng . tā réng xiǎng liàn , liǎnshàng méiyǒu hūrán huànchéng quán dǒng le de shénqíng .
pairs.english: Dema lowered her head, said yes, and fastened the box. She still wanted to practice; her face did not suddenly become all understanding.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛低头说是，把箱扣合上。她仍想练，脸上没有忽然换成全懂了的神情。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jìnlái shí , ménkǒu yǐjīng zhàn le bùshǎo rén .
pairs.english: By the time Instructor Vey entered, quite a crowd stood in the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师进来时，门口已经站了不少人。

pairs.target: shào lǐ bǎ qiānmíng zhǐ dìguòqù , shuō shēnqǐng de rén dōu zài .
pairs.english: Shaoli handed over the petition, saying its applicants were all present.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里把签名纸递过去，说申请的人都在。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lìkè shuō zìjǐ zài , dàn zhǐ shàng méi xiě yào zhàn héchàngduì de yùyuē .
pairs.english: Tavi immediately said he was there, but the paper had not said they would take the choir's reservation.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维立刻说自己在，但纸上没写要占合唱队的预约。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé jí , xiàng tì zìjǐ zhǎo gānjìng dìfāng , lián zìjǐ yě tīng chūlái le .
pairs.english: His hurried words sounded like seeking a clean place for himself, and even he heard it.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得急，像替自己找干净地方，连自己也听出来了。

pairs.target: yúshì tā yòu bǔ yíjù , zǎoshàng zìjǐ méi wènqīng , shì zìjǐ qiāndé tài kuài .
pairs.english: So he added that he had failed to ask clearly that morning and signed too quickly.
pairs.hanzi: 于是他又补一句，早上自己没问清，是自己签得太快。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ zhǐ dúwán , méiyǒu yīnwèi yǒu qīgè míngzì jiù jiào yīwén ràng wū .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey read the paper but did not tell Iven to yield merely because it held seven names.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把纸读完，没有因为有七个名字就叫伊文让屋。

pairs.target: tā shuō jīntiān zhào yuánlái pái de zǒu , jiājù shōu hǎo , xiǎng jiā de shíchén lìng tán .
pairs.english: She said today's original schedule stood: put away the fixtures and discuss extra time separately.
pairs.hanzi: 她说今天照原来排的走，夹具收好，想加的时辰另谈。

pairs.target: shào lǐ hái xiǎng kāikǒu , tā wèn tā shìbushì yǐjīng bǎ míngtiān yuándìng nà zǔ liànxí de huǒbàn zhǎoqí le .
pairs.english: Shaoli wanted to speak again. She asked whether he had gathered his partners for tomorrow's scheduled session.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里还想开口，她问他是不是已经把明天原定那组练习的伙伴找齐了。

pairs.target: tā shuō qí le , shēngyīn yìng le yìdiǎn . tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā yào xùn rén ,
pairs.english: He said yes, his voice a little harder. Tavi thought she was going to scold him.
pairs.hanzi:
他说齐了，声音硬了一点。
塔维以为她要训人，

pairs.target: tā què jiào tā liúxià míngdān , shuō kěyǐ wènwèn míng hòu liǎngtiān néng bunéng tíqián kāi wū .
pairs.english: Instead, she asked him to leave the list; she could ask whether the room might open earlier for the next two days.
pairs.hanzi: 她却叫他留下名单，说可以问问明后两天能不能提前开屋。

pairs.target: yào yǒurén kàn liànxí , bùnéng zhī bǎ yàoshi gěi tāmen .
pairs.english: Someone had to supervise practice; they could not simply be handed the key.
pairs.hanzi: 要有人看练习，不能只把钥匙给他们。

pairs.target: zuìzǎo míngtiān zǎofàn shí dáfù , zài nà yǐqián , méi rén yǒu xīn shíchén .
pairs.english: The earliest answer would be at breakfast tomorrow. Until then, nobody had any new hours.
pairs.hanzi: 最早明天早饭时答复，在那以前，没人有新时辰。

pairs.target: rén sàn dé búkuài . shào lǐ shōu zhǐ shí , tǎ wéi qǐng tā bǎ zìjǐ de míngzì cóng zhànyòng héchàng nà yíxiàng lǐ huàdiào .
pairs.english: People were slow to disperse. As Shaoli gathered the paper, Tavi asked him to remove his name from taking the choir's time.
pairs.hanzi: 人散得不快。邵里收纸时，塔维请他把自己的名字从占用合唱那一项里划掉。

pairs.target: shào lǐ shuō běnlái jiù méi xiě zhè yíxiàng . " nà jiù bié ná tā shuō wǒmen dōu dāying le . "
pairs.english: Shaoli said that had never been written there. “Then don't use it to say we all agreed.”
pairs.hanzi:
邵里说本来就没写这一项。
“那就别拿它说我们都答应了。”

pairs.target: shào lǐ kàn le tā yíhuìer , bǎ zhǐ zhéqǐlái , shuō xià huíxiǎng hǎo le zài qiān .
pairs.english: Shaoli looked at him for a while, folded the paper, and said to think before signing next time.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里看了他一会儿，把纸折起来，说下回想好了再签。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìng le yìshēng . zhèhuà bùquánshì cuò de , piānpiān cóng tā zuǐlǐ chūlái , tīng zhe géwài nánshòu .
pairs.english: Tavi acknowledged him. It wasn't wholly wrong, but coming from him it sounded especially painful.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维应了一声。这话不全是错的，偏偏从他嘴里出来，听着格外难受。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu guòlái ānwèi tā . tā yǐjīng zài wūlǐ shìyīn ,
pairs.english: Iven did not come to comfort him. He was already testing voices inside.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有过来安慰他。他已经在屋里试音，

pairs.target: shǒu tái dào yíbàn , xiān jiào rén bǎmén guān xiǎo , miǎnde shēngyīn quán pǎo dào zǒuláng .
pairs.english: His hand half raised, he first asked for the door to be partly closed so the sound would not all escape into the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 手抬到一半，先叫人把门关小，免得声音全跑到走廊。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài wàimiàn , shǒulǐ hái ná zhe nà kuài bù , zhídào dé mǎ wèn shìbushì yào bǎ tā dài qù chīfàn .
pairs.english: Tavi stood outside still holding the cloth until Dema asked whether he meant to take it to dinner.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在外面，手里还拿着那块布，直到德玛问是不是要把它带去吃饭。

pairs.target: liǎng rén bǎ qìcái sònghuí guìzi . dé mǎ shuō tā háishì xīwàng néng zǎo kāi ,
pairs.english: They returned the equipment to the cupboard. Dema said she still hoped for an early opening.
pairs.hanzi: 两人把器材送回柜子。德玛说她还是希望能早开，

pairs.target: bùxiǎng wèi biérén ràng yìhuí jiù zhuāngzuò zìjǐ búzàihu . tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ yě xīwàng .
pairs.english: She did not want to yield once and then pretend she no longer cared. Tavi said he hoped so too.
pairs.hanzi: 不想为别人让一回就装作自己不在乎。塔维说自己也希望。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le xiǎng , shuōmíng tiānzhēn qǐ dé zǎo , ràng tā qiāo yíxià mén , tā pà shuì guòtóu .
pairs.english: After thinking, she asked him to knock tomorrow if they really started early; she feared oversleeping.
pairs.hanzi: 她想了想，说明天真起得早，让他敲一下门，她怕睡过头。

pairs.target: huíqù jīngguò dōng wū , gēshēng yǐjīng liánchéng yíduàn .
pairs.english: Passing the east room on their way back, they heard the singing flow into a continuous passage.
pairs.hanzi: 回去经过东屋，歌声已经连成一段。

pairs.target: yīwén gé zhe ménfèng kànjiàn tǎ wéi , cháowài zhǐzhǐ gē běn , yòu shù le sāngēn shǒuzhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven saw Tavi through the door crack, pointed toward the songbook, and raised three fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文隔着门缝看见塔维，朝外指指歌本，又竖了三根手指。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi guò le yíhuìer cái míngbái , shì tíxǐng tā sāntiān hòu qù tīng .
pairs.english: It took Tavi a moment to understand: a reminder to come listen in three days.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维过了一会儿才明白，是提醒他三天后去听。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , méiyǒu wǎng lǐ jǐ . nà yíduàn hái méi chàng wán , tā zài ménwài duō zhàn le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: He nodded without pushing inside. The passage was not finished, and he stayed outside a little longer.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，没有往里挤。那一段还没唱完，他在门外多站了一会儿。
